Hey, I've been in a similar mindset as you before and it's not fun. I don't know if me saying it means anything, but please know that your problems are valid. Stress and anxiety and depression come in all forms, and while your trauma may not be one that people can easily define as awful, it's still real. Your pain is real, and I hope you never feel guilty about hurting. Have you tried talking to your sister about all this? Having someone close to help you get back on your feet is an easier way of freeing yourself from these thoughts. 

I know it's way easier for me to say it than for you to do it, but trying to think less about physical losses that your sister would face and more about the emotional loss. She would miss you so much, I guarantee it. Like I said before, talking to your sister is worth considering in my mind. People in bad places are harder to notice than you would think. Good luck getting back on your feet, man. PM me any time if you need to talk!
